name: Stuart Lewis-Evans
features: very slight frail build, pale drawn face, dark hair, delicate features, quiet watchful eyes
bio: Vanwall's third driver behind Moss and Brooks, and quick enough to take pole at Monaco and Casablanca. Frail-looking and troubled by a stomach ulcer he raced through. His engine seized in the 1958 Moroccan Grand Prix at Ain-Diab, the deciding race of the season; he died of his burns six days later, and Tony Vandervell closed the Vanwall team.
